CAPTAIN: Whew! Thank you!
I'm feeling much better now.\pYou want to see my hidden CUT
technique?\pI could show you my prized CUT
technique if I weren't so ill…\pI know! You can have this!
This HIDDEN MACHINE!\pTeach CUT to your POKéMON, and
you can see it CUT anytime!
Using CUT, you can chop down\nsmall trees.\pWhy not try it with the trees\naround VERMILION CITY?
CAPTAIN: …Whew!\pNow that I'm not sick anymore,\nI guess it's time.\pThe S.S. ANNE will set sail soon!\pFarewell, until our return to\nVERMILION CITY!
Oh, no!\nYou have no room for this!
How to Conquer Seasickness…\nThe CAPTAIN's reading this!
